verifiedButWrong.label: SYNTHETIC example (not a TapeOut circuit): verified, but computes another function than the reference
verifiedButWrong.note: SYNTHETIC example, not a TapeOut circuit and not read from any chain. It is built by hand to exercise the 'verified but computes another function' case of Specification §3.9: a 3-NAND OR netlist (g0 = NAND(a,a), g1 = NAND(b,b), out = NAND(g0,g1)) recorded as a verified miner of the public XOR task 3. It differs from the XOR reference circuit (raw/ref-task3.json) only on input 11. The processor 0x...dEaD and circuit id 900000001 are fictional; block, header, implementation, contract parameters and the task tuple are copied from the public recorded reads (raw/raw906.json) so that the snapshot has a realistic context. bestSlot describes a fictional slot holder (id 900000000, cost 108 like the public XOR holder #906). A real instance observed on chain is withheld until it has been disclosed to the TapeOut team.
